body: Remote test runs have a no-babysitting dispatch shape (coordinator decision, Termal::Fable2 mailbox 4daa5b87 #5028, 2026-11-08, after Greg's 'why Codex 6 is babysitting testrun? this is a big problem as it consumes the tokens'). Every remote FULL or focused job: the agent starts one background script that survives its turn (setsid/nohup on Linux, the Start-Process equivalent on Windows). The script runs the standard launcher once, hostless, with TERMAL_* removed for that child only. An EXIT trap using the inherited TERMAL_CLI sends END once to the integration owner with the run directory and exit code. The agent then ends its turn: no polling, sleep-loops, log tailing, status reads, progress posts or load sampling. --detach --notify is not used on remote clones for now, because an independent clone's registration is refused with HTTP 400 'run directory outside project' (w-5e2f3fba987a). The integration owner runs no watcher either: if a run goes quiet, it reads `summary RUN_DIRECTORY` once on an ordinary wake.
